messages.subject: Jens | Industrial & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Jens,

Your leadership of Kestria Mexico and more than three decades across executive search, manufacturing and consulting, together with your Industrial and Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure coverage, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition in a regulated operating environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, mining, energy and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Latin America, the Middle East, North America and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
